Shoplinker product registration

API for registering your own products as products composed of Shoplinker SKUs.

get https://apiweb.shoplinker.co.kr/ShoplinkerApi/Product/attribute_prod_insert.php?iteminfo_url=XML_URL[URL-encoded]

Request Parameters

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. Required customer_id string Customer code (Shoplinker registration code) Code issued by Shoplinker
ex) a0000001
2. Required partner_product_id string Your own product code (product management code) Product code managed in your own system
3. Required attribute_title_code string Product group attribute code Query field [attribute_title_code] in the SKU query API 999999999 when there are no attributes
4. Required attribute_partner_product_id string Your own SKU code 1. When there is only one
Example: BBMBSHOP12

2. To specify multiple SKU codes, enter them together separated by commas (,)
Example: BBMBSHOP12,BBMBSHOP13,BBMBSHOP14 		When multiple SKU codes registered in Shoplinker are sent, those SKUs form the product options
5. Required product_name string Product name
6. detail_desc string Detailed description
7. market_price integer Marketplace list price (book list price)
8. sale_price integer Marketplace sale price
9. supply_price integer Marketplace supply price
10. market_price_p integer Supplier market price (book list price)
11. sale_price_p integer Supplier selling price
12. supply_price_p integer Supplier supply price
13. sale_status string Product sale status Allowed values
  1. - On sale : 001
  2. - Sales suspended : 003
  3. - Sales ended : 006
14. maker_dt string Publication date (manufacturing date) yyyymmdd
18. tax_yn string Taxable Allowed values
  1. - Taxable : 001
  2. - Tax-exempt : 002
  3. - Zero-rated : 005
19. new_desc_top string New detailed description Optional value for ESM products
20. new_desc_center string Additional component detailed description Optional value for ESM products
21. new_desc_bottom string Advertising/promotional details Optional value for ESM products
22. salearea string Sales region
23. partner_id_tmp string Supplier ID The supplier ID can only be set when adding a product and cannot be updated.
Changing the supplier ID may create duplicate products. Use caution.
24. sex string Product gender Allowed values
  1. - Unisex : 001
  2. - Men's : 002
  3. - Women's : 003
25. keyword string Short product name
26. model string Model name
27. model_no string Model NO When using isbn (book code), the value must start with "isbn-".
28. brand string Brand name
29. auth_no string Certification number
30. expirydate string Valid date
31. product_description string Product summary description
32. desc_type_tag string Quality labeling TAG and detailed description Applies only to Hyundai Home Shopping
33. maker string Manufacturer
34. origin string Country of origin name/code Enter either the exact country of origin name or its code. e.g. South Korea OR APIORIGIN_031
Default : South Korea
35. adult_info string Adult product Allowed values
  1. - Adult product : Y
  2. - Not an adult product : N
36. ccategory_l string Customer category level 1 code Up to 10 alphanumeric characters Example: A01
37. ccategory_m string Customer category level 2 code Up to 10 alphanumeric characters Example: A01-01
38. ccategory_s string Customer category level 3 code Up to 10 alphanumeric characters Example: A01-01-01
39. ccategory_d string Customer category level 4 code Up to 10 alphanumeric characters Example: A01-01-01-1
40. expiry string Use-by date text
41. weight string Weight Digits only; decimal points are not allowed
ex)11
42. unit_price ▼ object Unit price information Click to expand child fields.
ㄴ type string Unit price input method Allowed values
  1. - Default input : default
  2. - Manual input : manual
ㄴ totalCapacity string Total capacity Example: numbers such as 1000, 2000 Required when type is default
ㄴ unitCapacity string Unit capacity Example: numbers such as 10, 20 Required when type is default
ㄴ indicationUnit string Display unit Example: g, kg, ml, L, cm, m, piece, pieces per pack, sheet, sheets per pack, item, capsule, gummy, sachet, ball Required when type is default
ㄴ direct_input_text string Manually entered text Total capacity / displayed capacity / display unit (e.g. 100/10/kg) Required when type is manual

<shoplinker>

			<product_name><![CDATA[키가 쑥쑥 자라는 비타민]></product_name>
			<sale_status>001</sale_status>

			<supply_price_p>20000</supply_price_p>
			<tax_yn>001</tax_yn>
			<detail_desc><![CDATA[<img src='http://사이트주소/aa.jpg'>]]></detail_desc>
			<new_desc_top><![CDATA[<img src='http://사이트주소/aa.jpg'>]]></new_desc_top>
			<new_desc_center><![CDATA[<img src='http://사이트주소/aa.jpg'>]]></new_desc_center>
			<new_desc_bottom><![CDATA[<img src='http://사이트주소/aa.jpg'>]]></new_desc_bottom>
			<desc_type_tag><![CDATA[<img src='http://사이트주소/aa.jpg'>]]></desc_type_tag>
			<quantity>900</quantity>
			<salearea><![CDATA[전국]]></salearea>
			<partner_id_tmp><![CDATA[]]></partner_id_tmp>
			<sex>001</sex>
			<keyword><![CDATA[걸리쉬,가디건]]></keyword>
			<model><![CDATA[MO1552]]></model>
			<model_no><![CDATA[s222]]></model_no>
			<brand><![CDATA[Senti]]></brand>

		</product>

</shoplinker>

Response

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. result bool Result flag Allowed values
  1. - Success : true
  2. - Failure : false
 Code issued by Shoplinker
ex) a0000001
2. product_id string Shoplinker product code Shoplinker product code
ex) prod0001213
3. message string Result message Success or failure message 
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="euc-kr"?>
<Shoplinker>
	<ResultMessage>
		<result>true</result>
		<product_id>P1524578</product_id>
		<message>등록성공</message>
	</ResultMessage>
</Shoplinker>
